swimwear-ref-04.title: Magenta gathered halter
swimwear-ref-04.judgment: The magenta colour, gathered bandeau volume and fine ties give this look a clear beachwear identity. A navy long-sleeve one-piece does not preserve that design proposition.
swimwear-ref-04.construction: Gathering runs across the bandeau between its upper and lower edges; fine halter straps rise from the front. The matching lower front is smooth, with bound-looking waist and leg edges, tie-side bows and long ends. No definite front dart is visible. Preserve the relationship between soft gathered volume and narrow ties.
swimwear-ref-04.fabricClass: Likely stretch-knit swim base · top structure unconfirmed
swimwear-ref-04.fabric: The close-fitting lower section is consistent with stretch swim knit. The lustrous gathered top cannot be confidently classified as knit or woven from this photograph alone. Shine is not proof of satin weave or silk. Fibre, lining and recovery remain unverified.
swimwear-ref-04.drape: Local, elastic-looking gathers create controlled fullness rather than broad fluid drape. Maintain fine fold scale; avoid inflating the top into a rigid padded shape.
swimwear-ref-04.uncertainty: No genuine rear source. Rear band shape, clasp or tie, halter attachment, lining and elastic application require owner or sample evidence.
swimwear-ref-04.styling: Contemporary premium beachwear, with restrained hoops, hair clear of the halter and minimal barefoot styling. Cast for ease, fit and the intended resort campaign; do not default to a racing-swimsuit or athlete presentation.
swimwear-ref-04.savedReview: Saved V1 Front and Editorial retain the magenta separates, gathered top and tie-side identity. They remain photographic studies, not verified patterns. V1 Back is absent.
swimwear-ref-04.decision: Retain the original silhouette, colour and tie construction. The owner should confirm authentic rear construction and campaign casting before any future production.
swimwear-ref-04.v2Review: Tide Panel is OWNER_REJECTED. Its navy long-sleeve one-piece replaces the source's gathered magenta separates and shifts the category emphasis toward athletic swim. It is preserved below as rejected evidence only.

evening-ref-02.title: Honeycomb off-shoulder column
evening-ref-02.judgment: The wide off-shoulder fold, openwork surface, low rear opening and long column-to-flare silhouette form a specific eveningwear proposition. Believable support and pattern shaping matter more than merely making the image photorealistic.
evening-ref-02.construction: A broad folded band wraps the upper arms and runs above a fitted column body. A seam is visible below the front fold. The rear source shows a low opening, thin horizontal tie and long bow ends, with a central rear line in the skirt. The hem gently flares and pools. Dart, side-seam and closure engineering are not fully resolved by the image; do not invent boning or a corset as fact.
evening-ref-02.fabricClass: Likely knit mesh / lace · inferred, not laboratory-verified
evening-ref-02.fabric: Regular honeycomb openwork suggests an engineered mesh or lace, plausibly warp-knitted. The image does not prove woven construction, hand crochet, fibre content or stretch percentage. Tonal foundation layers are part of the visible presentation; their exact cut is unverified.
evening-ref-02.drape: The gown needs a close upper fit and sufficient weight and release to make the flared pooling hem believable. Mesh scale must stay consistent between band, body and skirt; folds must follow the actual structure.
evening-ref-02.uncertainty: Front and rear source evidence exist, but band stabilisation, internal support, lining edges, seam allowances and fastening type remain unresolved. A rear tie alone is not proof of adequate gown support.
evening-ref-02.styling: Refined eveningwear casting: poised posture, restrained movement and hair lifted enough to show the rear band and tie. Select for the gown's proportions and campaign character, with no arbitrary age preset.
evening-ref-02.savedReview: Saved V1 Front and Back retain the beige honeycomb, broad band, low rear and long hem. Inspect mesh topology, band depth and apparent lining together; their technical QA is not owner artistic approval. V1 Editorial is absent.
evening-ref-02.decision: Preserve the mesh-gown concept. Ask the owner to confirm support, seam and lining logic before a further photograph or any proposed redesign.
evening-ref-02.v2Review: Forest Fold is OWNER_REJECTED. The green one-shoulder faille gown changes material, neckline, rear construction and design character. Technically coherent images did not establish that it was an acceptable replacement. V2 was specified as woven faille, an AI material interpretation rather than a verified textile; it does not preserve the source openwork drape.

swimwear-ref-02.title: Silver triangle and tie-side set
swimwear-ref-02.judgment: This is a deliberately simple triangle-and-tie silhouette. Its interest comes from reflective material, fit and proportion; shine alone is not evidence of exceptional fashion design. Evaluate those qualities clearly before considering a redesign.
swimwear-ref-02.construction: Triangular halter panels are gathered onto a narrow lower tie, with fine neck ties and a matching V-shaped lower front. Side bows and long ends are integral. No confirmed cup dart, moulded cup or structured support is visible. Keep tie gauge, panel proportions and lower-edge gathering consistent.
swimwear-ref-02.fabricClass: Likely coated / metallic stretch knit · inferred
swimwear-ref-02.fabric: The reflective surface is compatible with a metallic-finish stretch swim textile. Neither the coating method nor the underlying knit or fibre composition is confirmed. Do not substitute sequins, foil pleats or rigid metal-like panels.
swimwear-ref-02.drape: Small gathers and soft reflective creases should follow tension at ties and panel edges. Preserve flexible cloth behaviour and keep specular highlights readable rather than turning them into clipped white patches.
swimwear-ref-02.uncertainty: Only the front is historically documented. V1 Back is an inferred interpretation, including its rear fastening and lower rear shape; it is not an authenticated rear specification.
swimwear-ref-02.styling: Premium beachwear and resort styling, with quiet jewellery and a relaxed commercial stance. Cast for garment fit and confidence with reflective textiles; avoid dramatic posing or treating the look as competitive swimwear.
swimwear-ref-02.savedReview: Saved V1 Front and Back provide a consistent silver-set study. Compare material finish, triangle proportions, tie positions and model continuity. V1 Editorial is absent. The ochre V2 studies below are a different unapproved concept, not a reproduction.
swimwear-ref-02.decision: Keep the original silver design for review. A future owner-approved photography brief should control exposure, material highlights and a distinct restrained Editorial pose; unseen rear construction still needs confirmation.
swimwear-ref-02.v2Review: Ochre Wrap V2 has saved Back and Editorial views only. It was not owner-approved, is not featured, and its Front remains absent. Do not combine these ochre views with the silver V1 set.

swimwear-ref-05.title: Grey and white layered swimwear
swimwear-ref-05.judgment: The grey scoop layer over the white halter and the crossed waist straps are the design identity. Replacing that relationship with a conventional tankini removes the principal construction and styling idea.
swimwear-ref-05.construction: A grey scoop-front top with narrow shoulder straps sits over a white halter-shaped layer. The high-waisted grey lower section has additional narrow straps crossing into a V above the front waist. Bound edges are visible; no definite darts are resolved. Preserve separate layer edges and each strap's route.
swimwear-ref-05.fabricClass: Likely stretch swim knit in both colours · inferred
swimwear-ref-05.fabric: Smooth, close-fitting surfaces suggest stretch swim jersey or a comparable knit. Whether the layers are separate garments or joined internally is not established. Fibre, lining, elasticity and wet opacity require physical evidence.
swimwear-ref-05.drape: The grey outer layer should lie smooth while the white layer remains visibly separate at the neckline. Waist straps should sit under plausible tension without cutting through fabric or floating away from the garment.
swimwear-ref-05.uncertainty: No original rear view. Layer attachment, rear halter fastening, strap crossings at the back and internal support are unverified. Sunglasses can obscure casting assessment, so any change in styling needs an owner-approved campaign brief.
swimwear-ref-05.styling: Fashion-led resort minimalism, retaining the graphic grey/white layers and controlled accessories. Cast and fit-test for clear layer separation and natural posture rather than imposing a generic sports or tankini identity.
swimwear-ref-05.savedReview: Saved V1 Front retains the grey/white layer relationship and crossed waist straps. V1 Back and Editorial are absent. The olive V2 Front is a distinct unapproved concept; its pre-stop Back output was never accepted.
swimwear-ref-05.decision: Preserve the original layered design. Obtain rear and attachment evidence, then let the owner approve the photographic and casting brief before any further production.
swimwear-ref-05.v2Review: Olive Pique V2 is unapproved and not featured. Its Front was saved with a technical pass. The preserved Back is explicitly UNREVIEWED after production was stopped; neither establishes approval to replace the original.

swimwear-ref-06.title: Azure ring-linked halter
swimwear-ref-06.judgment: Azure colour and the relationship between gathered upper panels, crossing straps, central connector and shaped opening distinguish the look. A generic rashguard would erase that fashion-swim construction.
swimwear-ref-06.construction: Gathered halter cup panels feed into narrow crossed front straps above a small central connector. A teardrop opening descends into a high-waisted lower section; lateral waist openings separate upper and lower areas. Keep the connector position, opening proportions and actual strap intersections precise. No clear dart is visible.
swimwear-ref-06.fabric: The smooth, close-fitting azure cloth is consistent with stretch swim jersey. Fibre content, lining, connector composition and stretch recovery cannot be established from the photograph.
swimwear-ref-06.drape: Gathering should concentrate where straps meet the upper panels. The lower section should remain smooth, with openings held by believable seam and strap tension; avoid arbitrary extra openings or unsupported floating connectors.
swimwear-ref-06.uncertainty: The historical source documents Front only. Saved V1 Back's simple band and rear lower section are inferred. That image cannot verify unseen Front details, authentic rear cut or how the connector is reinforced.
swimwear-ref-06.styling: Contemporary premium fashion swimwear, not racing kit. Retain the source's concise sunglasses and hoop styling if the owner wants that campaign character; choose casting by fit and strap geometry rather than an age formula.
swimwear-ref-06.savedReview: Only V1 Back is saved. It is useful as a photographic study but does not establish the original rear pattern. There are no genuine saved V1 Front or Editorial outputs to show.
swimwear-ref-06.decision: Preserve the original azure design. The owner should confirm connector, seam and rear construction before considering future photographic completion.
swimwear-ref-06.v2Review: No V2 photographs exist for this slot. An earlier written concept plan is not an image, an approved design or a proposed replacement on this board.

activewear-ref-09.title: Ivory mesh fashion-active bodysuit
activewear-ref-09.recommendation: PROPOSE A NEW DESIGN FOR OWNER APPROVAL
activewear-ref-09.judgment: The mesh, opaque underlayer and waist bands have a fashion-active identity, reinforced by trainers and sports styling. The photograph does not establish training support or performance. The owner must decide whether fashion-active editorial or a performance product is the intended brief before any design proposal.
activewear-ref-09.construction: A mock neck and fine-mesh long sleeves continue into the fitted body. The visible opaque scoop underlayer has a curved lower rear neckline; an opaque lower panel and three narrow horizontal waist bands organise the silhouette. Tonal armhole and side seams are visible, but stitch type and internal attachment are not verified. No definite dart is visible.
activewear-ref-09.fabricClass: Likely fine stretch-knit mesh plus opaque knit panels · inferred
activewear-ref-09.fabric: Close fit and the fine mesh are consistent with stretch knits. The photo supplies no evidence for a woven shell, compression rating, moisture transport or tested durability. Apparent mesh openness is not proof of measured ventilation performance.
activewear-ref-09.drape: The body is intended to lie close and recover after movement; sleeve and waist-band tension should be physically credible. Actual recovery, support and comfort need a sample or technical specification.
activewear-ref-09.uncertainty: Both Front and Back source evidence exist. Internal support, panel joining, stretch direction, stitch engineering and movement suitability remain unverified. Existing sports branding is part of the historical source, not proof of client authorship or performance validation.
activewear-ref-09.styling: Commercially relevant fashion-active or performance styling, with purposeful trainers, headband and watch. Cast for believable movement, garment fit and campaign suitability. Do not reframe it as lingerie or arbitrarily assign a different model age.
activewear-ref-09.savedReview: No accepted generated Front, Back or Editorial photograph exists. The real two-view historical source is shown in full. No generated placeholder or unmade track-set concept is substituted.
activewear-ref-09.decision: Approval request only: first establish the intended activewear use and required function with the owner. If a new design brief is chosen, it must be developed and approved before any visual proposal is generated. No new garment is designed or authorised by this recommendation.
activewear-ref-09.v2Review: No V2 photographs exist. A previous unexecuted track-set specification is historical production planning, not an approved recommendation.

swimwear-ref-01.title: Grey gathers with neon binding
swimwear-ref-01.judgment: Grey and acid-yellow contrast, side gathering and long tie ends form a legible beachwear story. Keep that graphic balance rather than translating the slot into an unrelated one-piece.
swimwear-ref-01.construction: A softly gathered grey bandeau-shaped top has neon-bound upper and lower edges and narrow shoulder straps. The lower front has neon edging, separated side-strap lines and long tied ends. The source does not clearly establish a doubled shoulder-strap count; do not carry that claim forward from older prompts. No definite dart is visible.
swimwear-ref-01.fabricClass: Likely stretch swim knit with contrast binding · inferred
swimwear-ref-01.fabric: Smooth close-fitting grey cloth and narrow bound edges are consistent with stretch swim knit. The construction of the binding, fibre content and lining cannot be identified reliably from the image.
swimwear-ref-01.drape: Small side gathers introduce local softness in the top, while the lower front remains smooth. Preserve binding width and tension; long bows should hang naturally rather than becoming extra garment straps.
swimwear-ref-01.uncertainty: No rear source. Rear band, closure, shoulder-strap attachment and lower rear cut remain unknown. Exact strap count and routing need owner or physical-garment confirmation.
swimwear-ref-01.styling: Contemporary graphic beachwear: deliberate neon accents, restrained gold discs and the existing loose slicked-back hair and anklet character. Select campaign casting by the garment's attitude and fit, not by a generic athletic template.
swimwear-ref-01.savedReview: No accepted generated view exists. Failed or unsubmitted requests are not photographic evidence, so the board shows no invented Front, Back or Editorial.
swimwear-ref-01.decision: Preserve the grey/neon design. Confirm strap count and authentic rear evidence, then let the owner approve a garment-specific photo brief.
swimwear-ref-01.v2Review: No V2 photographs exist; no independently generated replacement is proposed.

swimwear-ref-03.title: Leopard print with red binding
swimwear-ref-03.judgment: The cool leopard print and red outline are the principal visual idea. The simple silhouette should be evaluated through print scale, edge quality and fit; a clean render alone does not make the design strong or justify replacing it.
swimwear-ref-03.construction: A shallow scoop/bandeau front is outlined by red neckline and lower binding, with narrow red shoulder straps. The matching lower front has red-bound edges and fine fixed-looking side straps. No tie bows or definite darts are visible. Exact shoulder-strand count is unresolved; preserve only what the source actually supports.
swimwear-ref-03.fabricClass: Likely printed stretch swim knit · inferred
swimwear-ref-03.fabric: The close-fitting printed surface is compatible with stretch swim jersey. Print method, fibre content and lining are unknown; the image does not establish woven fabric.
swimwear-ref-03.drape: The textile should remain smooth enough for the leopard scale and red borders to read clearly. Any future image must preserve the print's scale and orientation rather than inventing a new print distribution as a technical fact.
swimwear-ref-03.uncertainty: No historical rear evidence. Rear top shape, closure, print continuity across seams and exact strap arrangement need confirmation. Previous moderation outcomes do not assess fashion-design quality.
swimwear-ref-03.styling: Premium print-led beachwear with clean, restrained styling. Cast to support the graphic garment and natural commercial stance; retain hair clear of the neckline and avoid accessories that compete with the print.
swimwear-ref-03.savedReview: No accepted generated view exists. There is no saved Editorial photograph and no genuine generated Back to display.
swimwear-ref-03.decision: Improve photographic clarity while retaining the source silhouette and red/print balance. Have the owner approve print, strap and rear details before future production; no new design is proposed here.
swimwear-ref-03.v2Review: No V2 photographs exist; no replacement concept is shown or authorised.

swimwear-ref-07.title: Grey ruched wrap-tie set
swimwear-ref-07.judgment: Central gathering, forked halter straps and the long waist-wrap path create the design's sculptural identity. The routing needs to be resolved faithfully, not simplified into generic swimwear or multiplied for visual drama.
swimwear-ref-07.construction: A grey bandeau-shaped top gathers vertically at centre front and connects to forked halter straps. Narrow ties cross the waist in multiple visible X paths, meeting the lower garment near side rings and long bows. The lower front remains comparatively smooth. Do not infer extra darts, straps or ring hardware beyond what is visible.
swimwear-ref-07.fabric: The smooth grey surface, local ruching and fitted lower section are consistent with stretch swim knit. Fibre, surface finish, lining and ring material are unconfirmed.
swimwear-ref-07.drape: The top needs fine, controlled centre gathers. Wrap ties should follow one physically traceable route with plausible tension; bows should hang with their own weight without visually merging into garment seams.
swimwear-ref-07.uncertainty: Only a Front source exists. Continuous tie routing, side-ring attachment, rear top fastening and lower rear cut require an authenticated reference or owner specification. The exact wrap path should be confirmed rather than guessed.
swimwear-ref-07.styling: Sophisticated resort beachwear, with the source's slick loose hair, angular earrings and restrained anklet. Casting and pose should clarify the strap system and garment attitude; no arbitrary age brief or competition-swim styling.
swimwear-ref-07.savedReview: No accepted generated Front, Back or Editorial exists. Source material remains the only garment evidence shown.
swimwear-ref-07.decision: Preserve the original design and obtain a real strap-routing/rear reference. The owner should approve construction interpretation and campaign styling before further production.
swimwear-ref-07.v2Review: No V2 photographs exist. A written replacement idea is not shown as completed design evidence.
